authority: Explicit founder instruction in this thread: Founder Resource Authorization — Amendment to CEO-20261020-01

horizon.mode: rolling productive engineering under explicit founder weekly-quota authorization
horizon.duration_scope: Current remaining weekly allowance and qualified continuation after access is restored for the ongoing engineering objective; no forced 72-hour cutoff.

accounting.preserve: all historical totals, six failures, receipts, source and proposal pins; old 750k is not new debt
accounting.scope: every root, worker, reviewer, probe, model and resume
accounting.identity: provider request ID where available; otherwise stable thread/run/counter-epoch plus event identity; resumes retain identity unless counter reset is proven
accounting.method: deduplicate overlapping sources per identity, union disjoint usage, derive cumulative deltas within each epoch; retain corrections and provenance; never max aggregate DB and telemetry sums
accounting.baseline: snapshot all known cumulative counters at T0; retain pre-T0 history separately; unknown history is unresolved, never zero
accounting.subsets: uncached_input=input-cached_input; cached_input is within input; reasoning is within output; reject inconsistent counters
accounting.turn: persist start and end counters and charge their delta, including retries; use request receipts where concurrent usage prevents attribution
accounting.late: append corrections and attribute by event interval; pre-T0 usage stays historical; ambiguous intervals retain reservations until resolved
accounting.missing: Reserve bounded in-flight work before dispatch; retain unknown/late intervals with provenance. Reconcile without double charging. Account availability, not an arbitrary cumulative WPU reserve, governs the resource boundary.

planning.unit: WPU is internal planning/efficiency telemetry, never subscription consumption or money
planning.formula: sum(rate times corresponding token count divided by 1000000)

requirements: Useful authorized scope and observed progress or a justified recovery task
Fresh actual account entitlement and quota
Reconciled known usage plus explicit uncertainty and in-flight reservations
Bounded next actions, timeouts and protected recovery capacity
renewal.independent_review: Required for code acceptance and controller release; no additional CEO or independent-review permission is needed merely to renew an ordinary planning allocation.

bootstrap.scope: Existing accounting and release repair; independently reviewed maintenance may continue while pilot STOP remains

turn_control.incremental_raw_and_wpu_estimates: Keep per-task/per-turn estimates and reservations. Sol may adjust these planning estimates with provenance. Crossing an estimate causes reconcile/checkpoint/replan, not a claim of exhausted account quota. Do not restart an attempt blindly or erase retry history.
turn_control.runaway_protection: Retain wall deadlines, finite task attempts, lease fences, productive-progress checks and current-quota admission. No idle inference.

planning.uncertainty: Retain historical unknowns and bounded in-flight reservations separately. Unknown old tokens are not zero and are not newly charged debt. Missing current usage requires reconciliation or bounded reservations; unbounded active uncertainty blocks affected dispatch. Historical incompleteness alone is not a global resource STOP when current account access is verified.

quota.authoritative_signal: Actual account/rateLimits/read entitlement and applicable exposed account buckets; not raw tokens or WPU
quota.reduced_mode: One productive team; short bounded turns, review/recovery capacity retained; no blanket half-WPU rule
quota.reserve_adjustment: Sol may justify up to2 percentage points only when measured in-flight exposure or telemetry granularity needs it; record evidence and shrink it when safe. Never preserve a large arbitrary unused weekly allowance.
quota.poll: Before dispatch and after completion; at most5 minutes while active, at most60 seconds once any applicable bucket is95% or higher
quota.freshness: Admission requires a successful read no older than the applicable poll interval. An explicitly absent optional bucket is not an unknown required bucket. Unknown required entitlement/limit evidence fails closed for new dispatch.
quota.growth: Track observed usage growth and shorten reservations/concurrency near exhaustion; the former1-point/15-minute automatic STOP is removed.
provider_stops: access unavailable or no-subscription-only execution path
quota.reserve_use: At99% stop discretionary inference, persist/checkpoint deterministically first. Minimal bounded recovery inference may use the reserve only while actual account permission remains. At a genuine provider limit, no further inference.
quota.reset_recovery: Pause inference safely, preserve edits/commits/attempts/leases/usage and resource-pause reason. Non-inference polling may wait for restoration; the reset timestamp alone grants nothing. Require two successful fresh account readings at least60 seconds apart confirming access and a restored applicable window/remaining capacity. Reconcile processes, leases, stale results and integration intents through qualified recovery before resuming; never duplicate active work.
quota.automatic_resume: Authorized for the same objective through the qualified recovery mechanism when all remaining STOP reasons and release gates permit. No new Astra approval for ordinary quota reset or planning renewal.

concurrency.team: one Sol and at most one confined Luna; coordinator and reviewers count toward these limits

release.bootstrap_only: Existing STOP-preserving repair and its routine Sol-managed renewals; pilot operations still require the original applicable release gates.
release.requires: independent Sol review of exact candidate commit; bounded actual Luna confined work; counter-reset/resume/dedup/late-data and turn-delta verification; enforced budget, quota and STOP behavior; closure of applicable security and qualification gaps
release.approval: record exact reviewed pins and permitted scope before lifting STOP through its supported mechanism
release.broader_resume: goal, worker and supervisor resume require their own covered release gates; no inferred approval from bootstrap
release.unattended_maintainer: not qualified by the interactive handoff

governance.implementation_owner: Existing Sol root 01a15657-3558-79c1-86dc-6ed033c264df with its Luna workers; no duplicate team
governance.ordinary_renewals: Sol records and manages planning renewals and quota pauses/recovery without executive episodes
governance.exceptional_escalation: Only changes outside founder authority, objectives, protected capabilities or unavoidable external resources; never automatically launch Astra
governance.restrictions: all existing protected-data, acquisition, training, trading, main and remote restrictions remain
